transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Whether this line is a trackable, serialized item - the Scenario 1 classification, recomputed on every save from the item's Eligibility. It is what the two roll-ups on the body are computed from, and it is deliberately NOT a sync-control field: a change to it is a change to the order's classification and must re-trigger the sync.
